scope: Open-weight recipes for the Fuobe Originals (everything Higgsfield ships as its own), on ComfyUI and on hosted open models (fal, Replicate) that accept LoRA URLs. No Higgsfield API.

conventions.lora: name, url (direct file URL), page, file (local file name to use; civitai files are renamed because several are called V1.safetensors), trigger, strength, base, licence, commercial (outputs may be sold), hostedOk (may run on a third-party service such as fal/Replicate), download (direct | civitai-token | hf-gated), released, notes
conventions.template: final prompt = triggers + ', ' + template with {prompt} replaced; Fuobe's current withOssLoras() does the same for motions
conventions.civitai: civitai downloads answer 401 without a token: pass ?token=<user's civitai key> or mirror the file to Fuobe/fal storage first (allowed when the licence includes Rent/Sell; unverified that fal accepts tokenised civitai URLs).

hypothesisCheck.claim: Higgsfield's in-house models are open models repackaged with LoRAs or better wrapping.
hypothesisCheck.verdict: Partly right. Five Higgsfield-branded tools are open models with public LoRAs, confirmed in its web client: Angles (Qwen-Image-Edit 2509 + Multiple-angles + Lightning LoRAs), Animate / Recast (Wan 2.2 Animate), Infinite Talk (InfiniteTalk + FusioniX), Depth Map (Video Depth Anything), Remove Background (SAM 3). Soul 2.0 styles carry lora / lora_2 fields and DoP accepts raw .safetensors motions, so Soul and DoP presets are LoRAs on a self-hosted base that is not named anywhere public. Cinema Studio 4.0, Shorts Studio, Marketing Studio Image and Ads Studio run on closed partner models (Seedance 2.5, Gemini Omni Flash, GPT Image 2.5). Updated by the critic pass on 2026-10-23 from higgsfield-originals-5.json.

evidenceFor.fact: The web bundle's job types include open models run by Higgsfield: infinite_talk (InfiniteTalk, Apache-2.0), sam_3_video (SAM 3), depth_anything_video, z_image (Z-Image), plus wan2_2 ... wan3_0 jobs.
Cinema Studio 4.0 runs on Seedance 2.5 (ByteDance) and Speak has a wan2_5_speak job: flagship 'studios' wrap third-party models.

Soul v1 takes style_id + style_strength 0-1 and custom_reference_id + custom_reference_strength 0-1; 'custom_reference_strength=0 uses the selected style's default character strength'. A per-style weight plus a per-user weight is how stacked LoRAs/adapters are exposed.
Soul ID trains a reusable character from 1-100 photos into an id with a 0-1 strength, the usual shape of a per-user LoRA.
The legacy DoP API takes motions: [{id, strength}] for dop-lite / dop-turbo / dop-standard, the same shape as stacking camera LoRAs on one base.
evidenceFor.source: npm @higgsfield/client 0.2.6 types (higgsfield-api.json legacy/dop; unverified, possibly retired)

evidenceFor.fact: Soul 2.0 costs $0.0032 per 720p image on Higgsfield's API, the price class of a 4-6B distilled open model (fal: Z-Image Turbo $0.005/MP, FLUX.2 klein 4B $0.01/MP). This is an inference from price only.

Client job types name open models under Higgsfield product names: QWEN_CAMERA_CONTROL = 'Higgsfield Angles' (sends loras [{lightx}, {camera_angle}]), WAN2_2_ANIMATE_V3 = 'Higgsfield Recast', InfiniteTalk with a 'fusex' LoRA at rank 32.

Every Soul 2.0 / Soul Cinema style record has lora and lora_2 fields, shown to staff as 'LoRA 1' / 'LoRA 2' next to '(Dev) Preset Strength' and '(Dev) Character Strength' sliders; DoP's motion picker accepts loras/<name>.safetensors ids ('Higgsfield Canary').

evidenceAgainst.fact: Higgsfield calls Soul, Popcorn and DOP 'native' models and publishes no model card or base model.

Weak: on Soul 2.0's public API, style_strength 'is accepted by the request schema but currently has no effect'. The web client still has a staff preset-strength slider next to the LoRA fields, so the public API ignoring the field does not show that styles aren't LoRAs.
No public statement, model card or leak found that names Soul's or DoP's base model.

hypothesisCheck.consequence: It does not change the plan: every Original below is built from open weights Fuobe can name and licence, whatever Higgsfield uses inside.
hypothesisCheck.trainingNote: Do not train Fuobe LoRAs on Higgsfield outputs or preset preview images. Higgsfield's Terms of Use (https://higgsfield.ai/terms-of-use-agreement, last updated 2026-10-23) forbid it. Section 5.2(iv) bars using 'the Service, any Outputs, or any data derived therefrom to train, fine-tune, distill, or otherwise transfer knowledge to any machine-learning model ... whether or not such system competes with the Service'. Section 5.1(iii) bars using Outputs to 'develop, modify, fine-tune, distill, or improve' competing products, and 5.2(v) bars reverse engineering the Service. Copyright also applies. Use Fuobe-owned or licensed references.

evidenceNeutral.fact: Higgsfield ships Genjutsu Motion Transfer as a ComfyUI partner node. It is a cloud API node that downloads no model and bills per output second, so it says nothing about the model inside (moved from evidenceFor by the critic pass).

template.enhancer: Before the template, expand short user prompts to 60-120 words with Fuobe's prompt enhancer (Claude / Ollama / offline): subject, wardrobe, pose, place, light, lens, film stock. Applied in the browser today; for API jobs it needs a server-side port (a small ComfyUI colour node chain or the same shader in a worker).
postGrade.paletteLock: When the user picks a Soul HEX palette: run oss-palette-image (palette-transfer-image, strength 0.8) after generation, as Fuobe already does for open models.
postGrade.upscale: 1080p tier and above: SeedVR2 (open: upscale-image-seedvr2; hosted: fal-ai/seedvr/upscale/image at $0.001 per megapixel).
postGrade.overlays: Text and frames that diffusion draws badly are added in post: date stamp (DigitalCam), CCTV camera ID and time, photo-booth strip layout, ID-card crop (dmv), pixelated face (SAM 3.1 face mask + mosaic).

soulId.what: Higgsfield's Soul ID trains a reusable character from 1-100 photos (POST /v1/custom-references, model_version v1 | v2 | cinema) and is used as custom_reference_id with a 0-1 strength.
soulId.open: AI-Toolkit job (existing aiToolkitJob in src/lib/catalog/training.ts) on Z-Image Turbo with ostris/zimage_turbo_training_adapter v2 (Apache-2.0), 10-30 photos, captions with a unique trigger, rank 16-32, 1,500-2,500 steps; output copied into ComfyUI/models/loras.

buildPlan.summary: No Higgsfield provider, key or preset id; every Higgsfield in-house product becomes a Fuobe Original on ComfyUI and on open weights hosted by fal / Replicate; partner models stay as separate choices.
licencePolicy: Default = commercial-safe on both engines. An Original's default base and default LoRAs must allow selling outputs *and* running the weights on the user's GPU *and* on fal/Replicate: Apache-2.0, MIT, OpenRAIL-M, the SAM License, or civitai permissions that include Image and Rent. LTX-2.x is allowed by default, but About & licences shows its US$10M-revenue condition.

Flag, never default: FLUX.1 / FLUX.2 [dev], FLUX.1 Krea [dev], FLUX.2 [klein] 9B, Video-Depth-Anything Base/Large, DA3 Large/Giant/Nested, MMAudio, inswapper (ReActor): non-commercial weights. HunyuanVideo 1.5, HunyuanVideo-Foley, Hunyuan3D 2.1, MiniMax H3: territory-restricted. Krea 2, Stable Audio 3: revenue-tier community licences. A flagged model may be offered as a labelled alternative. A non-commercial model that fal hosts under its own output licence (e.g. fal-ai/depth-anything-video, fal-ai/mmaudio-v2) is "hosted only, fal's output terms", never an Original.

civitai RentCivit-only LoRAs (Wiggle, RackFocus, Medieval-CE…) are local-only: they run on the user's GPU and are never sent to fal or Replicate. LoRAs without Image (FrutigerAero, Mobile Cell Phone, Japan 1980s, Time-lapse, Eyes In, DroneShot) are not used at all.

No Higgsfield data. Per Terms §5.1(iii) / §5.2(iv) / §5.2(v): no training, captions, prompts, covers or tests built from Higgsfield outputs, preview media or client code. Preset *names* that are generic words stay; Higgsfield preset UUIDs survive only in a one-way migration map for old saved settings.

Enforced by tests: the generators fail when an Original's default LoRA has commercial: false, when a cloud payload carries a LoRA with hostedOk: false, or when a civitai entry has no pinned version id or permission snapshot.
